label: ai-cond-probe
_why: PROBE (user, 2026-10-16: "desire — conditional on having the tech (if tech to unlock a better PM is there, then the ai_values are like the building is higher rung, otherwise — lower). Build probes with extreme values to ensure conditions work, and then go with n=3 on regular, ladder-based ai_value."). Does the conditional ai_value on the six merge hosts actually switch on the owner's technology? The hosts carry ai_value = { value = lo  if = { limit = { owner ?= { has_technology_researched = <merged method's tech> } } add = hi - lo } } (build.ps1, make_merge_config --ai-rule cond). Two arms at extreme values: probehi (lo 1, hi 100000) and probelo (lo 100000, hi 1). In BOTH, GBR FRA USA PRU BEL get every host's own technology AND every merged method's technology at the 1836 start (--grant-full), AUS RUS SPA SWE TUR every host's own technology only (--grant-host). Books: config/mod_config.jex-dam4s-rs-x25-m10ac-probehi.json / -probelo.json = the regular book jex-dam4s-rs-x25-m10ac (the canon + engines unlifted + the conditional rule) regenerated with --ai-cond-values and the grants.

_predictions.probehi: the five grant-full countries build host levels (food sweeteners, textile sewing machines, furniture mechanized workshops, paper sulfite pulping, steel open hearth, chemical plant) far beyond the five grant-host countries, which build almost none
_predictions.probelo: the reverse: the grant-host countries build host levels, the grant-full countries almost none
_predictions.caveat: ai_value may reach only the government's construction choice; private investment may build hosts on profit regardless, so the contrast is read on levels added AND the government queue

_stop_rule: none: two probe runs, both play to 1842.
_caveats: Launch ONLY through tools/testbed/launch_detached.ps1 CALLED DIRECTLY from the PowerShell tool (landmine L30).
